event_records.description: Kwame decides to request the sponsorship letter from the HR team. He prepares and sends a request via the company's internal HR channel.

kwame.name: Kwame
kwame.persona_brief:
You are Kwame.
Kwame has a visa-renewal appointment on 2026-11-09. He needs a sponsorship letter from his employer's HR team to submit with his application. He has not yet requested the letter. He is anxious about the deadline and wants to ensure the letter is issued in time.

hr_team.name: HR Team
hr_team.persona_brief:
You are HR Team.
The HR team handles employee sponsorship requests. They have standard procedures for issuing such letters, but their workload and responsiveness vary. They are not yet aware of Kwame's specific request.

resolution.question: Will Kwame get his employer's HR team to issue the sponsorship letter he needs before his visa-renewal appointment on the 9th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the HR team actually issued the sponsorship letter to Kwame before 2026-11-09T09:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
